summary: The first kick of the wished tree enters dokick.c:kick_nondoor’s IS_TREE arm. This recording takes the fruit branch: C creates two pears, scatters them with MAY_HIT, and one hits the hero. js/dokick.js immediately refuses the tree arm before its first tree RNG call, so all later screens and 37 RNG calls are unmatched. rnd_treefruit_at() and scatter() already exist in JavaScript; the missing behavior is their source-ordered wiring and effects in kick_nondoor(). A whole-function port must also replace the other live refusals in this function.

source.branch: When the kicked map square satisfies IS_TREE (on this recorded arboreal level), C first draws rn2(3). For this case that is zero; it then draws rn2(15), finds TREE_LOOTED clear, and creates fruit. rnd_treefruit_at selects PEAR; rnl(7)=6 makes a stack of two; scatter(x,y,2,MAY_HIT,treefruit) scatters the stack and may hit the hero. The source then exercises Dexterity and Wisdom, redraws the tree, sets TREE_LOOTED, and returns ECMD_TIME. The other C branches include a painful kick with optional buzzing and a killer-bee swarm.
callers: dokick.c::dokick() at 1465-1468 calls kick_nondoor() for a non-door target after monster, pool, and object handling. The production JavaScript route is js/cmd.js::runKickCommand() -> js/dokick.js::dokick() -> kick_nondoor() at 1071.
dependencies: mkobj.c::rnd_treefruit_at() at 1978-1987 chooses from the fixed treefruits array and calls mksobj_at(). It is already implemented as js/obj.js::rnd_treefruit_at() at 1824-1836, but js/dokick.js does not import or call it.

explode.c::scatter() at 721-947 receives MAY_HIT and the fruit stack; its effects include the recorded pear hit on the hero. It is already exported as js/explode.js::scatter() at 768, but js/dokick.js does not import or call it.
dokick.c::kick_ouch() at 881-906 is the existing helper for the painful tree outcome; it is implemented in the same JavaScript file.

The alternate tree-swarm arm also calls enexto() and makemon() with MM_ANGRY|MM_NOMSG, and uses makemon() success to select its message. This case does not reach that arm; full kick_nondoor() scope still needs the source behavior and the actual runtime call contract.

Other currently refused kick_nondoor() branches remain in whole-function scope, including secret doors/corridors, fountains (water_damage), grave headstone destruction, sinks (sink_backs_up), and throne/altar branches with their source effects. The selected fruit replay does not validate those branches.
